proofs.text: Run the command with `--json` over a TypeScript file whose first test passes an options object to a call and whose second title carries an apostrophe; verify both proofs come back with status `pass`

rule_text: The JavaScript reader bounds a test body by balancing braces, so a nested options object does not truncate it and an apostrophe inside a title does not drop the test

tests.name: test_check_js_tokenizer_handles_braces_and_apostrophes
